# 01 Package scaffold and core board: mount, re-render, error/diagnostics

## Outcome

`pnpm --filter @siren/board test` runs against a real `createBoard` that mounts a Siren diagram
into a container, re-renders on `setSource`, keeps the last successful diagram + controller
visible through a failed `setSource`, and reports diagnostics. No control bar yet (ticket 02) and
no demo migration yet (tickets 03/04) — this ticket's observable behavior is the board itself,
proven through its own test suite.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `createBoard(container, { source })` calls `@siren/core`'s `render()`, mounts the resulting
      SVG inside `container`, and applies full-bleed CSS (container fills 100%/100%, SVG
      `width`/`height` stretched to 100% so its `viewBox` scales it — no `ResizeObserver`).
- [ ] `board.controller` exposes the `AnimationController` from the most recent *successful*
      render; it is `null` before any successful render has happened.
- [ ] `board.diagnostics` exposes the diagnostics array from the most recent `setSource`/
      construction call, successful or not.
- [ ] `board.setSource(newSource)` re-renders synchronously and updates `controller`/`diagnostics`
      accordingly.
- [ ] When `setSource` fails (`render()` returns `svg: null`), the previously mounted diagram
      stays in the DOM, `board.controller` keeps pointing at the previous successful controller
      (does not become `null`), `board.diagnostics` reflects the failing call, and an error banner
      element is present in the container, overlaid on top of the existing diagram (not replacing
      it).
- [ ] `options.onDiagnostics(diagnostics)` fires on every `setSource`/construction call, including
      calls that only produce non-fatal warnings (`svg !== null` but `diagnostics.length > 0`).
- [ ] `options.measureText` overrides the default text measurer; when omitted, board supplies its
      own real canvas-based `TextMeasurer` (a `document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d')`
      measurer, equivalent to the one currently hand-rolled in both demo files).
- [ ] A `<style>` element carrying board's chrome CSS is appended to `document.head` the first
      time `createBoard` is called on a page; a second `createBoard` call on the same page does
      not append a second copy.
- [ ] `board.destroy()` removes this instance's DOM subtree and any listeners it attached; it does
      not remove the shared injected `<style>` element. Calling `destroy()` a second time is a
      no-op (no throw).
- [ ] Constructing `createBoard(container)` with no `source` mounts nothing yet (no error, no
      diagram) until `setSource` is called for the first time.

## Test seam

`createBoard`/`Board` (the package's full public interface) — integration tests under jsdom
(vitest, matching `packages/core`'s existing setup), each test supplying a fake `measureText` via
`options.measureText` rather than depending on jsdom's incomplete canvas support. Assert on
`container`'s resulting DOM structure, `board.controller`/`board.diagnostics`, and callback
invocations — not on any internal module.
